%iso(vista, k, ox, oy):
  c:cos(π/6)
  s:sin(π/6)
  if vista=="T":
    T:[c,-c,0;s,s,0;0,0,1]
  elif vista=="L":
    T:[c,0,0;s,1,0;0,0,1]
  else:
    T:[-c,0,0;s,1,0;0,0,1]
  M:[T_(1,1),T_(1,2);T_(2,1),T_(2,2)]
  Q:M*transpose(M)
  th:0.5*atan2(2*Q_(1,2); Q_(1,1)-Q_(2,2))
  m1:(Q_(1,1)+Q_(2,2))/2
  m2:sqrt(((Q_(1,1)-Q_(2,2))/2)^2+Q_(1,2)^2)
  s1:sqrt(m1+m2)
  s2:sqrt(m1-m2)
  dt:det(M)
  if isa(k; "group"):
    for i in 1..k.n:
      iso(vista; k_i; ox; oy)
  elif isa(k; "contour"):
    for i in 1..k.n:
      iso(vista; k_i; ox; oy)
  elif isa(k; "circle"):
    C:T*[k.c.x;k.c.y;1]
    point("P"+k.c; ox+C_1; oy+C_2)
    point("A"+k+"a"; ox+C_1+k.r*s1*cos(th); oy+C_2+k.r*s1*sin(th))
    point("A"+k+"b"; ox+C_1-k.r*s2*sin(th); oy+C_2+k.r*s2*cos(th))
    ellipse("P"+k.c; "A"+k+"a"; "A"+k+"b")
  elif isa(k; "line"):
    A:T*[k.a.x;k.a.y;1]
    B:T*[k.b.x;k.b.y;1]
    point("P"+k.a; ox+A_1; oy+A_2)
    point("P"+k.b; ox+B_1; oy+B_2)
    line("P"+k.a; "P"+k.b)
  elif isa(k; "arc"):
    r:hypot(k.a.x-k.c.x; k.a.y-k.c.y)
    C:T*[k.c.x;k.c.y;1]
    A:T*[k.a.x;k.a.y;1]
    B:T*[k.b.x;k.b.y;1]
    point("P"+k.c; ox+C_1; oy+C_2)
    point("P"+k.a; ox+A_1; oy+A_2)
    point("P"+k.b; ox+B_1; oy+B_2)
    point("A"+k+"a"; ox+C_1+r*s1*cos(th); oy+C_2+r*s1*sin(th))
    point("A"+k+"b"; ox+C_1-r*s2*sin(th); oy+C_2+r*s2*cos(th))
    if dt<0:
      earc("P"+k.c; "A"+k+"a"; "A"+k+"b"; "P"+k.b; "P"+k.a)
    else:
      earc("P"+k.c; "A"+k+"a"; "A"+k+"b"; "P"+k.a; "P"+k.b)
  k
